_readme: Copy this file to remote-config.json and edit it. That name is in .gitignore.
Everything here can also be set as an environment variable; the environment wins.
users: at least 12 characters. This is reachable from the internet.
publicUrl: leave it out to use a Cloudflare quick tunnel (new address each start).
Set it once you have a named tunnel or your own domain, so the address stays put.
allowBooks: leave it out to allow every company book, or list the ones a remote
session may see. A remote connection is allowed to be narrower than a local one.
allowCidr: set to 160.79.104.0/21 to accept only Anthropic's servers. That covers
Claude web, Desktop and mobile, and blocks Claude Code on another computer,
which connects directly from that computer instead.
